summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Builds and evaluates computer vision models in PyTorch: U-Net segmentation scored on Dice and IoU, YOLOv8 detection on self-curated datasets, and DONUT VLM fine-tuning from 55% to 93% accuracy. Optimizes models for edge deployment with TensorRT and 8-bit quantization, reaching a 5.2x speedup on NVIDIA Jetson.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU; reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free vision-language transformer) on a custom dataset for structured field extraction, improving validation accuracy from 55% to 93%.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch with the HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API; added domain special tokens and resized decoder embeddings.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom object detection dataset, training YOLOv8n on 1,133 images to 83% mAP@50; exported to ONNX and TFLite for on-device deployment.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with +/-8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) - MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Optimized YOLO detection with TensorRT on a Jetson camera pipeline for a 5.2x speedup (56.7 to 10.9 ms, 17.6 to 92 FPS) over eager PyTorch.
Analyzed and resolved 11 integration failure cases (false positives, stale-frame capture, servo brown-out) to reach 100% pick reliability over 10 trials.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated ground-truth generation using semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering, producing ~8,000 YOLO and UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50 ~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18); validated in Town02 with zero collisions across multiple laps.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Cut GPU memory ~55% via 8-bit quantization (LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and latency with pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC with <1% accuracy degradation, quantifying the edge efficiency trade-off.
